description: This PHP source file defines the ValidationUniqueDao class, responsible for checking the uniqueness of entity attribute values within the OrangeHRM system's database. The class extends BaseDao and provides a method to verify if a given value is unique for a specified entity and attribute, with optional matching criteria.

classes.name: ValidationUniqueDao
classes.description: A data access object responsible for validating the uniqueness of entity attribute values in the database.

methods.name: isValueUnique
methods.description: Checks whether a given value is unique for a specified entity and attribute, considering optional matching and exclusion criteria.
